Figure type: Diagram
Description: The figure is a diagram illustrating the process of neural image caption generation with visual attention. It shows four main steps: 1) Input Image, 2) Convolutional Feature Extraction, 3) RNN with attention over the image, and 4) Word by word generation. The process starts with an input image, which is then processed through convolutional layers to extract features. These features are then fed into an RNN with attention, which generates a sequence of words describing the image. The attention mechanism is visualized in the third step, showing the model's focus on specific parts of the image.

caption: Figure 4. A LSTM cell, lines with bolded squares imply projections with a learnt weight vector. Each cell learns how to weigh its input components (input gate), while learning how to modulate that contribution to the memory (input modulator). It also learns weights which erase the memory cell (forget gate), and weights which control how this memory should be emitted (output gate).
